guide.purpose: What it is for. Each request spends one token from its user's bucket; a burst empties it, the next request is refused, and the bucket refills at a steady rate. Every user's bucket lives centrally, in Redis.
lines: Under the hood, Stripe uses the token bucket algorithm.
Every user gets a bucket; each request takes a token,
and fresh tokens drip back in slowly.
If requests come faster than the drip, the bucket runs empty.
If the bucket is empty, the request is rejected.
The buckets live centrally, in Redis.
